## A quick look at fuel efficiency

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(cyl)), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel efficiency vs. weight",
    subtitle = "Cars with more cylinders tend to be heavier and less efficient",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per gallon",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
